# Track B staging — live curriculum evidence catalogue

**Status:** Staging / analysis only. Does **not** mutate Golden A or programme truth.

## Regenerated by

```bash
node scripts/catalogue-live-curriculum.mjs
```

Requires Desktop Autocare packs + local `.tmp-live/` short-path extracts. PDF text extraction uses `pdf-parse` if present in `node_modules` (optional: `npm install pdf-parse --no-save`).

## Outputs

| File | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `catalogue-resources.json` | Per-file resource records (hash, era, Group/Block, role, extraction) |
| `catalogue-relationships.json` | Explicit vs inferred edges |
| `catalogue-summary.json` | Counts, findings, frozen Golden A reminder |
| `sample-chains.json` | Tyres / Brakes / EV shadow chains |
| `extracts/*.txt` | Extracted text samples (where extraction succeeded) |

## Hard rules retained

- Learning Materials = mixed Group-era corpus
- G01 empty; G09 empty / “Now not needed”
- Practical Tasks 3–4 only
- Group-era ≠ Block-era sessions
- Transition Guide = routing only
- Lesson-plan KSB lists = intent only
- Same-named resources may be variants (check hashes)
- Golden A frozen: 45 / 18 / 1 / 0 / 611.5
